messagesPage.title: Messages
messagesPage.subtitle: Operational messages from leaders. Replies go to the sender’s email.

empty.sentDescription: Message a team or the people on a plan from the plan’s Teams tab.

messageDetail.notAvailableDescription: It was not sent to you, or you are no longer an active member.
messageDetail.variablesNote: Shown as written; each recipient received it with their own variables filled in.
messageDetail.simulatedNote: “Simulated” means no email provider is configured — the email was not sent. Only failed or uncertain deliveries can be retried.
messageDetail.notSentNoAddress: Not sent · no email or sign-in

audienceInclude.scheduled_pending: Not yet answered on this plan

errors.recipient_not_eligible: No longer scheduled or no longer a member
errors.scheduler_not_active: Scheduler is no longer active in this organization
errors.request_missing: The availability request no longer exists
errors.provider_timeout: Provider did not answer in time
errors.outcome_unknown: Interrupted while sending; it may have been sent
errors.worker_lease_expired: Worker stopped before sending; will retry
errors.reminder_obsolete: Reminder no longer applied when it was about to be sent
errors.provider_duplicate_key: Provider already has an earlier attempt of this message; it may have been sent
errors.content_removed: The comment or message was removed before it was sent

chatPage.title: Chat
chatPage.subtitle: Team and plan conversations.
chatPage.noConversations: No conversations yet. Open your team’s chat, or a plan’s chat from the plan page.

conversation.notAvailableDescription: Conversations are open to the people on that team or plan. If you were removed, you can no longer read it.
conversation.noMessages: No messages yet. Say hello to the team.
conversation.privacyNote: Only current team or plan members can read this. Muting stops notifications. Direct messages and attachments are not available yet.

reportModal.title: Report message
reportModal.thanks: Thanks. The conversation’s moderators will review it. Reporting again does not create a second report.

composer.notSent: Not sent: {{reason}} Your text is kept; sending again will not post twice.

itemDiscussion.title: Discuss “{{item}}”
itemDiscussion.noItemNotes: No notes on this item for you.
itemDiscussion.unavailable: This discussion is open to plan leaders and the people scheduled on this plan.
itemDiscussion.noComments: No comments yet. Ask a question or leave a cue for the team.
itemDiscussion.deleteConfirm: Delete this comment? The thread keeps a “deleted” placeholder.
itemDiscussion.mentionNote: Mentioning someone does not give them access; only people on this plan are notified.

messageComposer.replayed: This message had already been sent; nothing was sent twice.
messageComposer.outcomesNote: Delivery outcomes appear as each channel finishes.
messageComposer.limitTeamsHint: Limit to teams (optional; required for team members):
messageComposer.staleNotice: The audience changed since your preview. Nothing was sent — review the updated list, then send again.
messageComposer.unreachable: No email or sign-in — can’t be reached
messageComposer.repliesNote: Replies go to your email address. They are not shown in the app.

noteEditor.audienceHint: Plan leaders can always read every note. Older apps show only the plan’s simple note.
noteEditor.placeholder: Cues, logistics or anything this audience should read.
noteEditor.simpleNoteHint: This is the plan’s simple note, which older apps also show. Saving it with a category or another audience makes it an ordinary note and removes it from older apps.

audienceDetail.organization: Every active member of the organization can read it.
audienceDetail.scheduled: People with a request on this plan they haven’t declined can read it, as can plan leaders. Prepared, unreleased requests don’t count.
audienceDetail.teams: Members of {{teams}}, people scheduled on those teams here, their schedulers and plan leaders can read it.
audienceDetail.teamsNone: Choose the teams that can read it.
audienceDetail.leaders: Only plan leaders — people who edit this plan or schedule its service type — can read it.

noteEditor.stale: Someone changed this note since you opened it, so nothing was saved. The latest version is below. Your text is still here.
noteEditor.keepMine: Save my text over the latest
noteEditor.gone: This note was deleted, or you can no longer read it. Your text is still here.

notesPanel.title: Notes
notesPanel.empty: There are no notes for this plan.

mobileNotes.uncertain: The server did not answer, so this note may or may not have been saved. The notes have been refreshed — check them before saving again.
mobileNotes.categoryGone: That category is no longer offered on this plan, so the note was not saved. It is now filed under General — check it and save again.
mobileNotes.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the notes. Showing the plan’s simple note only.
